# How much can you claim for business miles?

> Free UK business mileage calculator using HMRC approved rates (45p/25p). Employees: see tax relief on what your employer under-pays. Self-employed: compare simplified mileage with actual vehicle costs. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
